likert.reason: Conversational, peer-like tone ('even a sketch this rough tells me something') with genuine curiosity about the user's situation rather than judgment.
All figures (€1,200 fixed, €1,500 free, €170 pot, €1,120 drift, €48 subscriptions) are directly traceable to the persona data provided and used consistently.
Uses tangible comparisons ('6% of take-home,' '3 months instead of 10'), avoids prescriptive language, frames as observation ('tells me something worth acting on') rather than directive.

Directly addresses the user's own flagged uncertainty ('You flagged that yourself as unsure'), acknowledges their life shift (rent increase), and respects their top value by not lecturing against experiences.
Concrete next step (€300/mo standing transfer, real month check) with clear rationale, and CTA button points to immediate follow-up that unlocks deeper insight (56% → 70%).
